composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. creative_direction: Paint a swallow turning gently in flight with two sweeping wings and a short loose pale-blue ribbon held in its beak. Keep the ribbon secondary, curving below the body without forming a border. Use deep blue watercolor for the back, a muted apricot throat, and translucent feather tips. Place the bird diagonally on warm white paper, balancing the forked tail against the wing arc with generous space around every part. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
